children: Argentina's unemployment rate reached 7.9% in the second quarter of 2026, the country's official statistics agency said on Thursday, marking the third consecutive quarter on the rise.
The unemployment rate rose slightly from the 7.6% registered the same period a year earlier, while increasing from 7.8% in the prior quarter.
